忠保"From his movements, at least he doesn't seem unconnected. And one other thing..."
小夏"What?"
忠保"Outside school, remember? He stopped Uehara and questioned him."
雄飛"Yes. Uehara made that irritated face at first, then suddenly became very quiet."
小夏"Exactly. That bothered me too."
忠保"At that point—unless I saw wrong—he showed the teacher a gun."
雄飛"—"
小夏"A g-gun?"
忠保"Pistol. From inside his coat, just one quick glimpse. The model, I couldn't make out."
雄飛"No wonder Uehara got scared..."

en.html:
雄飛"Even if he's a Rokuhara warrior... right now he's unarmed. We can manage."
小夏"Unarmed? Yuhi. The gun?"
忠保"Compared with a tsurugi, a pea-shooter, certainly. For us, however, both are much the same sort of killing weapon."
雄飛"If it doesn't hit, no problem!"
小夏"And if it hits?"
雄飛"Bear it with fighting spirit. Keep advancing."
忠保"...Wasn't there somebody who said much the same and lost an entire cavalry army?"
小夏"Some plan, at least?"
雄飛"I stand in front and get his attention. Tadayasu, you hit him from behind."
忠保"Heavenly strategy."
雄飛"Thank you."
小夏"Sarcasm is not reaching him..."
忠保"Full charge-mode now, I think. Worry for Ritsu, excitement at finding an enemy, fear of Rokuhara turned inside out—mix them, and here we are. That would be my analysis."
小夏"What do we do?"
忠保"Why not go along?"
小夏"You're serious?"
忠保"Look. He's entering the lane behind the rice shop. Easy to circle around there. We could actually do Yuhi's plan."
小夏"But..."
忠保"Catch him, and there's a great deal to gain. We would have to question him properly."
忠保"Well, perhaps we can manage. Might even find out where Ritsu is."
小夏"..."
雄飛"Tadayasu. Ready?"
忠保"Okay. I'll pick up an iron pipe or something at the scrap yard, then circle around. Start where the drainage channel bends."
雄飛"Got it."
小夏"...Yuhi! Don't get hurt, all right?!"
雄飛"Right!"

en.html:
I knew I was reaching far above myself. A reckless attempt. My palms were sweating.

The plan was nonsense. Surprise him, and perhaps we could deal with the pistol. But what had the plan forgotten?

The warrior himself.

Armor off, training also off? It did not work like that. A warrior remained a master of fighting. Not somebody ordinary civilians could fight.

The man ahead was, to put it modestly, <ruby>powerfully built<rt>powerfully built</rt></ruby> beyond the ordinary level. His movements were unhurried; he must have trained a great deal. Army warrior or not, ordinary he was not.

Reckless, yes. But there could be a contest.

One enemy. No tsurugi. A fight was possible.

I would not have to stand there crying, helpless.

en.html:
The man stopped and turned.

Face to face.

He looked at me. I looked at him.

Quiet <ruby>eyes<rt>eyes</rt></ruby>.

Without meaning to, I stopped. Stumbled, tried to recover my footing.

Tadayasu was already running up behind him, astonishingly fast. Perhaps hearing his steps, the man turned again.

Say something. I had to say something.

No voice.

The man looked straight at Tadayasu. Tadayasu did not hesitate.

The iron pipe pointed skyward.

The man watched.

It swung down, cutting heavily through the air.

The man watched.

It touched his forehead.

The man watched—

Right to the end, he watched.

The iron pipe pointed skyward.

It swung down, cutting heavily through the air.

The man watched.

It touched his forehead.

Right to the end, he watched.

　最後まで見ていた。
